nodes.procedure: Subsequent hydrothermal treatment led to the uniform growth of NiMoO4·xH2O precursor nanorods on the NF, as evidenced by Scanning electron microscope (SEM) characterization. These nanorods exhibited a well-defined 1D morphology with diameters ranging from 0.6 to 1.0 μm.

nodes.name: Nitridation and heterostructure formation
nodes.procedure: Following pyrolysis, dicyandiamide decomposes into N-containing gaseous intermediates at high temperature. Upon reacting with the ammonium molybdate precursor [Note: text says NiMoO4 precursor, but context indicates ammonium molybdate involvement], these species facilitate the simultaneous formation of metal nitrides and an in situ N-doped carbon layer. The resulting heterostructured Ni0.2Mo0.8N/MoO2 nanorods retain their 1D architecture while developing a roughened surface composed of densely packed, uniformly sized nanoparticles.

nodes.evidence_snippet: The high-resolution O 1s XPS spectra... reveal the binding energies of 530.3, 531.4, and 532.8 eV, corresponding to lattice oxygen, surface oxygen (Ov), and... weakly bound oxygen species (H2O)... oxygen vacancy content... ≈24.2% for Ni0.2Mo0.8N / MoO2@NF...
